questions.question: When King Solomon planned to build the temple, what did he ask King Hiram of Tyre to send, as Hiram had sent to David?
When King Solomon planned to build the temple, why did he say no one could truly build a house for God?

answers.text: Even the highest heavens cannot contain Him
No one on earth has enough gold for it
The whole land of Israel is too small

questions.question: King Solomon asked King Hiram of Tyre to send him a craftsman skilled in engraving for the temple. True or false?
King Solomon told King Hiram that the temple he planned to build would be great. What reason did he give?

answers.text: Because God is greater than all gods
Because the kings around him had temples
Because Israel is stronger than Tyre
